title: The Quiet Watch
intro: Survey crews learn the coast while you are away. Let their notes accumulate, then choose a constellation to study. The harbor has no need for a sleepless keeper.
completion: The watch stations can carry a night without you. Their patient records reveal the channels that the darkness hid.
hints: Collect twelve completed Surveys over your visits.
Calibration patterns are an optional discovery; accessible completion gives the same result.
